title: Jordan Frame in Supergravity and Cosmology
summary: The superconformal action can be gauge-fixed in a gauge where is leads to the Einstein frame supergravity defined by a Kahler potential $K(z, \bar z)$, or in a gauge where it leads to a Jordan frame supergravity defined by the frame function $Ω(z, \bar z)$, in addition to $K(z, \bar z)$. We present new supergravity $ξ$-attractor models with non-minimal gravity coupling. They describe potentials with an exponential and a polynomial approach to the plateau.
